definitions.explanation: A rice bowl topped with three different colored toppings, typically scrambled egg (yellow), seasoned ground meat (brown), and green vegetables such as blanched spinach or green beans.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{昼食|ちゅうしょく}は{三色丼|さんしょくどん}です。
examples.english: Today's lunch is a three-color rice bowl.

examples.japanese: {三色丼|さんしょくどん}は{彩|いろど}りがきれいで{子|こ}どもに{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: The three-color rice bowl is colorful and popular with children.

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}そぼろと{炒|い}り{卵|たまご}とインゲンで{三色丼|さんしょくどん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a three-color rice bowl with seasoned ground chicken, scrambled egg, and green beans.

notes:
A compound of {三色|さんしょく} (three colors) and {丼|どん} (rice bowl). The visual appeal of three contrasting colors arranged on white rice is the defining feature. A staple of home cooking and school lunch menus in Japan.

TYPICAL TOPPINGS:
- {黄|き}: {炒|い}り{卵|たまご} (scrambled egg)
- {茶|ちゃ}: {鶏|とり}そぼろ or {豚|ぶた}そぼろ (seasoned ground chicken or pork)
- {緑|みどり}: さやインゲン, ほうれん{草|そう}, {絹|きぬ}さや (green beans, spinach, snow peas)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三色丼|さんしょくどん}を{作|つく}る: to make a three-color rice bowl
- {三色丼|さんしょくどん}{弁当|べんとう}: three-color bento

RELATED WORDS:
- そぼろ{丼|どん}: ground meat rice bowl — often just one or two toppings
- {親子丼|おやこどん}: chicken and egg rice bowl
- {海鮮|かいせん}{三色丼|さんしょくどん}: seafood three-color bowl — sashimi version with three types of fish
